record.question: A Government servant allows his residence to be used as a meeting point for organising support to a candidate in a municipal election. Under CCS (Conduct) Rules, this is best treated as:
options: permissible because it concerns a local authority and not Parliament
permissible if the meeting is outside office hours
permissible if no Government property is used
impermissible because it amounts to assisting or using influence in connection with an election
